summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 11.8.0: idrac_attributes accepts string or integer SNMP.1.AgentCommunity on iDRAC10, idrac_diagnostics has no SOCKS proxy export, and same-named uplinks are modified.
questions: What openmanage issues were known in Ansible 11.8.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (11.8.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_attributes`: accepts string or integer for `SNMP.1.AgentCommunity` on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
